description: Set whether a landing page is served by PostKing ('hosted', the default) or by the customer's OWN infrastructure ('self_hosted'). Self-hosted means the customer runs their own renderer against the public landing-pages API (GET /api/landing-pages/{slug}?host=<host>, GET /api/blog-posts?slug=<slug>, GET /api/blog-posts/{articleSlug}?slug=<slug>) instead of PostKing/universal-lp serving the page. A minimal, MIT-licensed example is https://github.com/bitsandtea/postking-selfhost — optional, not required; any custom build against those endpoints works the same. Once set to self_hosted, localhost testing against this page works immediately, no domain needed. For a production host, add a Domain with hostingMode: 'self_hosted' (add_domain), verify it (verify_domain — TXT ownership only), then connect_landing_page_domain. Also sets the page's public URL settings: siteBaseUrl (https origin the URLs are built on) and sidePagePattern (e.g. '/p/{slug}/') and a trailingSlash toggle. distribution 'external' means your own site serves the content: no domain is connected (switching to external while one is connected 409s). Mode-match rule: if a Domain is ALREADY connected to this page and its hostingMode disagrees with the new distribution value, this 409s asking you to disconnect that domain first — the two settings can never disagree.

distribution.description: 'hosted' (default, PostKing/universal-lp serves it), 'self_hosted' (you run your own renderer against the public API) or 'external' (your own site serves it; PostKing only emits URLs from siteBaseUrl + sidePagePattern, no domain may be connected).

sidePagePattern.description: Side-page path pattern; must contain {slug} ({lang} optional), e.g. '/p/{slug}/'. Default '/{slug}'. null clears.

siteBaseUrl.description: https origin (optional path) the page's public URLs are built on, e.g. https://example.com. Overrides the connected-domain base. null clears.

trailingSlash.description: Convenience toggle: true makes side-page URLs end with '/', false removes it (default off, slashless). Rewrites the stored sidePagePattern; with none set, true materializes '{pathPrefix}/{slug}/'. Can be combined with sidePagePattern.

name: set_landing_page_distribution
